desc: Ideation: identified telescoping reduction to a one-dimensional shortest-path DP and an O(n^2) quadratic candidate.
Implement the O(n^2) one-dimensional DP in the starter code using the transition dp[b] = min_{a<b} dp[a] + k*C[n] + C[a]*(S[a] - S[b] - k), returning dp[n] + S[n]*C[n].
Validate the implementation against the two provided examples and a brute-force partition enumerator on small random arrays, including n = 1 and a maximum-size performance check.
Finalize the solution; no fallback or further optimization is needed.
